notes: Hide-and-seek is Party & Casual and the Childhood Game preset is the right build, but the answers make the house interior the entire play space, so I took interior-single from the shared catalogue instead of the preset's space-bounded — the whole map is one enclosed building with no exterior to generate, which also means no P3, since there is no outside-to-inside transition to link. Dropped the preset's obstacle-maze because the answers describe clear rooms and hiding spots rather than a warren whose topology is the challenge, and dropping it keeps the build off P6 honestly rather than by preference. cover-los carries the closets, furniture and clutter that make the hiding work, and social-hub is a room used for gathering between rounds at the stated 8-player size. With no stated round end I took the genre default that a round closes when the seeker tags the last hider, which is what trigger-scoring places.
